title: kb!: a person reports on the session's last kb answer from the prompt, at no model tokens
goal: A prompt starting kb!: in Claude Code is handled by kb_hook.py beside kb: and kb+:: it writes one 'feedback' row joined to the session's last kb entry (its session_id and prompt_id, and that entry's pack handle when it has one), reads path:line references, urls and the words wrong, stale, outdated and missing deterministically into the closed fields of kb_feedback, keeps the rest as a rule-redacted comment with class unclassified in the local spool only (D-rd64qovu), prints a one-line receipt naming the id and what will check it, and blocks the prompt so no model turn runs; a kb!: with no earlier kb entry in the session says so and records nothing; the hook makes no network call (D-gmrjivyw).

run:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
# kb!: after a kb lookup in the same session: blocked, one feedback row joined to the session's last kb entry, its
# path:line and the word wrong read into closed fields, a receipt naming the FB- id; any socket connect exits 99
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=str(tmp), CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=str(Path('.').resolve()))
spool = tmp / 'querylog' / 'spool'
spool.mkdir(parents=True)
(spool / 'sess1.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps({'id': '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'ts': '2026-10-16T10:00:00Z', 'surface': 'kb_hook', 'v': 1, 'session_id': 'sess1', 'prompt_id': 'p1', 'question': 'how is the status line turned off', 'verdict': 'good', 'lines': [], 'pack': 'P-0123abcd'}) + '\n')
ev = {'hook_event_name': 'UserPromptSubmit', 'session_id': 'sess1', 'prompt_id': 'p2', 'prompt': 'kb!: that answer is wrong, see kb/public/claude/statusline.md:27'}
run = ("import socket, runpy, sys\n"
       "socket.socket.connect = lambda *a: sys.exit(99)\n"
       "sys.argv = ['kb_hook.py']\n"
       "runpy.run_path('_tools/kb_hook.py', run_name='__main__')\n")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', run], input=json.dumps(ev), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=25)
try:
    out = json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else {}
except ValueError:
    out = {}
rows = [json.loads(l) for f in spool.rglob('*.jsonl') for l in f.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
fb = [r for r in rows if r.get('surface') == 'feedback']
lines = json.dumps(fb[0].get('lines')) if fb else ''
print('exit', p.returncode, '| decision', out.get('decision'), '| feedback rows', len(fb), '| lines', lines[:120])
ok = (p.returncode == 0 and out.get('decision') == 'block' and 'FB-' in str(out.get('reason', '')) and len(fb) == 1
      and fb[0].get('session_id') == 'sess1' and fb[0].get('judged_by') == 'user' and 'statusline.md:27' in lines
      and 'wrong' in lines)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

# kb!: in a session with no earlier kb entry: says so (blocked with a reason) and records nothing
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
env = dict(os.environ, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=str(tmp), CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=str(Path('.').resolve()))

spool.mkdir(parents=True)

p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kb_hook.py'], input=json.dumps(ev), capture_output=True, text=True, env=env, timeout=25)
try:
    out = json.loads(p.stdout) if p.stdout.strip() else {}
except ValueError:
    out = {}
rows = [json.loads(l) for f in spool.rglob('*.jsonl') for l in f.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
fb = [r for r in rows if r.get('surface') == 'feedback']
print('decision', out.get('decision'), '| reason', str(out.get('reason', ''))[:100], '| feedback rows', len(fb))
sys.exit(0 if out.get('decision') == 'block' and out.get('reason') and not fb else 1)

notes: Premise: _tools/kb_hook.py handles kb: and kb+: only; a person who sees a wrong answer has no channel but a new prompt the pipeline reads as another lookup. AGENTS.md is capped at 4096 bytes and nearly full: naming kb!: there needs a cut elsewhere in the same commit (wc -c AGENTS.md). Comment text: D-rd64qovu. Plan 2026-10-17: _tools/tests.py left the touches (nothing in it reads the kb: prefixes). Checks: 0 plants a kb_hook spool row and runs the hook in-process with any socket connect exiting 99 (blocked, one feedback row joined to sess1, judged_by user, the path:line and wrong read); 1 a session with no kb entry (blocked with a reason, no row). Both exit 1 on 7cb5e0cbb (no kb!: handling). Gate g1 (operator): AGENTS.md stays as it is (4091 of 4096 bytes).
